skill_concept: Identify a specific code-level vulnerability class (CWE / XSS attack vector) in existing code, write or patch defensive code to neutralize it, and verify the attack vector is closed.
verdict_reason: Both tasks involve identifying and neutralizing a specific injection vulnerability class and verifying the fix, which aligns with the candidate skill. However, fix-code-vulnerability requires CWE identification, structured reporting (report.jsonl), and surgical code patching of an existing framework, while filter-js-from-html requires building a new standalone HTML sanitization tool from scratch — the procedure shapes diverge enough that a single reusable skill would need to be written at a high level of generality to cover both.
weakest_link_reason: This task does not involve identifying a vulnerability in existing code or writing a CWE report — it is purely about constructing a new sanitization utility, skipping the analysis and patch phases central to the candidate skill.
